chunks: And to many an apostle We have mentioned before, and to many other apostles We have not mentioned to you; and to Moses God spoke directly.
ai.seo_question: Which prophet did Allah speak to directly according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the completeness of the Quranic narrative while acknowledging the vast number of prophets sent to various nations, with Moses (AS) holding a unique rank of direct divine speech (Taklīman). This distinction highlights the hierarchy of prophethood, where Musa is often regarded as the chief of the prophets (Khalīlullah) due to this direct communion, a concept central to understanding his leadership in both the Torah and the Quranic tradition.
